description: Every migration lint finding Antifailure can report. The id is stable across releases and is what a filter should match on. The rule name and the title are prose and are rewritten whenever a clearer one exists.

findings.title: no lock_timeout, so a lock wait becomes an outage

CHECK constraint added without NOT VALID
unique constraint that builds its index in place
rows changed in the same transaction as the schema
column renamed while something still reads it
column dropped while a view still selects it
